html: קרן (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; cf. Assyrian ḳarnu, Arabic قَرْنٌ, Ethiopic ቀርን: NH קֶרֶן, Ph. קרן, Aramaic קַרְנָא, ܩܰܪܢܳܐ, all horn; Sab. קרן spur of mt.(?) HomChrest. 127; v. also Arabic قَرْنٌ part of man’s head where horns are in beasts, قُرْنَةٌ corner, extremity, of anything Frey, horn of uterus, Lane).
